"Banna Re Bagama Jhula Ghalya" is from the movie Ganga Ki Kasam (1999). This is a popular Bollywood film featuring Mithun Chakraborty and Deepti Bhatnagar. The song is a folk-style track with a catchy tune, and the film itself was a drama that revolved around themes of love, sacrifice, and family.
